subject: Intro from CloudBridge — quick demo coordination for Acme Trade
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@cloudbridge.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@acmetrade.com>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 15:17:00 -0700
Subject: Intro — Acme Trade (referral) interested in Redwood demo

Hi Marissa / Ethan —

Quick intro: I work with Acme Trade on cloud modernization (CloudBridge). Rajiv is evaluating inference platforms for a new customer-facing recommendation feature; they completed a trial sign-up on your hosted API and asked for a short product walkthrough focused on latency, cost controls, and private deployment options.

Rajiv, meet Marissa (Enterprise SDR / AE) and Ethan (Solutions Engineer) at Redwood — they can run a 30-minute demo tailored to your use case.

Could we pencil something next week? Rajiv mentioned PST mornings or early afternoons work best. I attached a one-page referral note with high-level context.

Attachments: cloudbridge-referral-note.pdf (pdf)

Thanks —
Priya Shah
Partnerships, CloudBridge
priya.shah@cloudbridge.io
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@acmetrade.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@cloudbridge.io>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro — Acme Trade (referral) interested in Redwood demo

Hi Rajiv — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks Priya for the intro.

We'd love to show a focused 30-minute demo that hits:
- quick architecture + deployment modes (hosted / dedicated / private)
- live generation latency and cost controls (batching, quantization)
- dashboard + rollout examples (canary / fallback)

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue 2 Jun, 10:00–10:30am
- Tue 2 Jun, 2:00–2:30pm
- Wed 3 Jun, 9:00–9:30am

If none work, tell me your preferred window and we’ll adapt. I attached a short demo agenda and a link to my schedulable calendar if you want to pick a slot quickly: https://calendly.com/marissa/redwood-demo-30

Also, if you have any specific compliance or architecture docs (data residency, audit logs) send them over and we’ll make sure to address them.

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
